mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mq_outbox WHERE status = 1 AND update_time < #{cutoff} ORDER BY update_time, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS messageCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN create_time < #{cutoff} THEN 1 END) AS overdueCount FROM mq_outbox WHERE status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = #{status}, attempts = #{attempts}, next_attempt_time = #{nextAttemptTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
